name: math
prompt: A train leaves Krakow at 08:15 and travels at 72 km/h. A second train leaves Warsaw at 09:00 and travels at 96 km/h on the same line, 295 km away. At what time do they meet, and how far from Krakow? Show every step and check the answer.

name: sql

name: summary
prompt:
Summarize the following text in exactly three bullet points, each at most 15 words, and then list the five most important numbers from it:

A regional electricity operator reported that peak demand rose 7.4% year over year to 3,182 MW on 12 August. The grid operator curtailed 214 MWh of solar generation and 96 MWh of wind generation during the afternoon. Two 110 kV substations were upgraded, adding 84 MVA of capacity, and the operator connected 1,930 new rooftop photovoltaic installations with a combined capacity of 18.6 MW. The average outage duration fell from 41 to 27 minutes, while the number of unplanned outages rose from 312 to 349. The operator plans to spend 420 million euros over four years, of which 38% is for digital control systems.
